data.title: Partnership Manager
data.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez Pennylane ?

L’ANECS et le CJEC réunissent une génération qui contribue déjà à façonner le cabinet de demain : collaborateurs en cabinet, stagiaires experts-comptables, mémorialistes, jeunes diplômés, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes experts-comptables installés.
Tous ne créeront pas leur cabinet. Beaucoup évolueront au sein de structures existantes et participeront directement à leur transformation : nouvelles pratiques de production, développement de nouvelles missions, adoption de l’IA, structuration commerciale, attractivité des équipes et amélioration de la productivité.
Pour les membres en phase d’installation, de reprise ou déjà installés, les enjeux sont très concrets : choisir les bons outils, développer leur activité, structurer les équipes et les missions, gagner en efficacité et identifier de nouveaux leviers de croissance. Pennylane a un rôle à jouer au-delà de celui d’un simple éditeur : devenir un partenaire de développement business et de productivité pour les cabinets qui se créent, se transforment et grandissent.

L’ANECS et le CJEC constituent un écosystème national et régional dense, avec près de 50 sections. Les bureaux se renouvellent en alternance, une année sur deux, ce qui demande une animation relationnelle continue et une transmission structurée entre les équipes sortantes et entrantes.

Ce poste est clé pour :

  • construire une préférence durable pour Pennylane auprès de la nouvelle génération de la profession comptable ;

  • accompagner les membres dans leurs enjeux de carrière, de développement de cabinet et de transformation des pratiques ;

  • transformer les partenariats, événements et prises de parole en contacts qualifiés, signaux d’intention et opportunités ;

  • sécuriser une relation continue avec les instances nationales et les sections régionales ;

  • faire de Pennylane un partenaire reconnu pour développer le business et la productivité des cabinets.


Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

  • Tu construis et animes la relation entre Pennylane et l’écosystème ANECS-CJEC. Ta mission est de faire de Pennylane un partenaire de référence pour celles et ceux qui font évoluer la profession comptable : futurs experts-comptables, collaborateurs en cabinet, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes installés.

  • Tu combines une forte présence terrain, l’animation d’une communauté active, la construction de contenus utiles et un travail étroit avec l’équipe commerciale. Tu développes une connaissance fine des membres, de leurs parcours et de leurs besoins afin d’identifier les moments pertinents pour activer Pennylane : évolution professionnelle, projet d’installation, reprise, recrutement, développement de nouvelles missions ou besoin de gagner en productivité.

  • Tu pilotes la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC, animes le réseau des sections régionales et assures la continuité de la relation lors du renouvellement alterné des bureaux.

  • Tu conçois et portes les activations les plus pertinentes : événements, ateliers, contenus, formats communautaires et prises de parole.

  • En lien étroit avec l’équipe commerciale, tu contribues aux initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets. Tu développes une communauté qualifiée, identifies les signaux d’intention et assures la bonne transmission des opportunités aux équipes commerciales, au bon moment dans le parcours de chaque contact.

  • Tu seras rattaché·e à Cyril Chanson, Manager Partenariats – Profession Comptable, et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Éducation et Événementiel.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?
Pilotage du partenariat national — 20 %

  • Porter la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC de bout en bout : convention annuelle, gouvernance, budget, négociation des contreparties et plan d’activation.

  • Gérer le budget sponsoring et événementiel, estimé à environ35 k€ par an, et en suivre le retour sur investissement.

  • Sécuriser puis activer les contreparties les plus utiles : visibilité, contenus, prises de parole, accès aux sections, formats exclusifs et opportunités de qualification.

  • Construire une relation de confiance avec les instances nationales et assurer la continuité du partenariat dans la durée.


Animation du réseau et présence terrain — 30 %

  • Animer la communauté ANECS-CJEC au niveau national et régional, avec une présence régulière auprès des sections, de leurs bureaux et de leurs membres.

  • Maintenir un mapping fiable des élus, ambassadeurs et relais locaux ; préparer activement les passations entre bureaux sortants et entrants.

  • Construire et exécuter un plan de présence terrain ambitieux et priorisé : congrès, Estivales, DEC After, soirées jeunes inscrits, Olympiades, Journées des Jeunes Inscrits, tables rondes et événements locaux.

  • Concevoir des activations utiles et engageantes : ateliers, témoignages, formats de networking, démonstrations, échanges entre pairs et prises de parole.

  • Assurer le suivi post-événement : qualification des contacts, activation de la communauté, transmission des signaux pertinents aux équipes commerciales et partage des apprentissages terrain.

  • Travailler avec la responsable événementielle sur la préparation et l’organisation des événements prioritaires.

Initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets — 20 %

  • Co-construire avec l’équipe commerciale les initiatives destinées aux créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets : ciblage, calendrier, offres, contenus, événements et parcours d’activation.

  • Apporter une connaissance fine des parcours, besoins et signaux d’intention observés au sein de la communauté ANECS-CJEC.

  • Identifier les moments où Pennylane peut créer de la valeur : installation, reprise, structuration d’équipe, choix des outils, développement de nouvelles missions, vente, IA ou productivité.

  • Qualifier et transmettre les contacts et projets à fort potentiel à l’équipe commerciale selon un processus partagé.

  • Suivre, avec l’équipe commerciale, la contribution de ces initiatives au pipeline et au MRR attribuables au canal.


Stratégie d’activation, contenus et communauté — 20 %

  • Définir et animer une stratégie de communauté combinant présence physique, rendez-vous digitaux, contenus, email, social media et relais locaux.

  • Concevoir des formats utiles aux membres à chaque étape de leur parcours : réussite du diplôme, découverte des formes d’exercice, installation, reprise, développement ou modernisation d’un cabinet.

  • Développer des contenus et événements autour des enjeux qui transforment les cabinets : IA, productivité, nouvelles missions, organisation, recrutement, développement commercial et expérience client.

  • Formaliser les besoins, briefer l’équipe Enablement et coordonner la production des contenus.

  • Construire, segmenter et animer dans la durée une base de communauté qualifiée, dans le respect des règles de consentement et de gestion des données.


Pilotage de la performance et veille — 10 %

  • Suivre la couverture du réseau, les contacts générés, la qualité des leads, l’engagement de la communauté, les signaux détectés, le pipeline influencé, le MRR attribuable, le budget et le ROI.

  • Produire un reporting trimestriel présentant les résultats, les apprentissages terrain et les arbitrages de priorisation recommandés.

  • Assurer une veille sur les initiatives des concurrents auprès des jeunes professionnels de la profession comptable et proposer les réponses adaptées.

  • Identifier les territoires, sections et formats les plus performants afin de concentrer les moyens sur les actions à plus fort potentiel.


Profil recherché :
Tu disposes d’environ 4 à 6 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats B2B, l’animation de réseau, le community growth, le développement commercial indirect ou le marketing terrain à forte dimension business.
Tu as déjà évolué dans un environnement où il faut articuler une stratégie nationale avec des relais locaux : partenaires, antennes, ambassadeurs, clients et équipes internes. Tu sais transformer une présence terrain ou une communauté en dynamique mesurable de contacts, d’engagement et d’opportunités.
Tu apprécies particulièrement le terrain, les déplacements réguliers en région et les échanges directs avec des communautés professionnelles. Tu es autant à l’aise dans une relation avec un président de section que dans l’animation d’un atelier devant des membres, ou dans le suivi rigoureux d’une base de contacts et de ses signaux business.

Compétences indispensables :

  • Animation de réseau et de communauté: créer des relations durables avec des interlocuteurs variés, identifier les bons relais, animer une communauté et maintenir la continuité malgré les changements de personnes.

  • Appétence terrain: aimer aller au contact des professionnels dans les régions, participer à des événements et transformer une présence ponctuelle en relation durable.

  • Partenariats stratégiques: piloter une convention nationale, négocier des contreparties, gérer un budget et faire vivre un partenariat au-delà de sa signature.

  • Orientation business: identifier les actions, sections et événements les plus porteurs ; comprendre les besoins des membres et faire remonter les bons signaux à l’équipe commerciale.

  • Community growth: structurer une base de contacts, la segmenter, créer des séquences d’animation et développer l’engagement dans la durée.

  • Prise de parole et pédagogie: animer un atelier ou un webinaire, et rendre accessibles des sujets liés à la vente, l’IA, la productivité, les missions ou le développement du cabinet.

  • Pilotage par la donnée: suivre l’engagement, les signaux, la couverture territoriale, le pipeline, le MRR attribuable et le ROI des activations.

  • Coordination transverse: travailler efficacement avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Éducation et Événementiel.

  • Autonomie: prendre en main un périmètre national, proposer un plan, l’exécuter et faire remonter les arbitrages nécessaires au bon moment.


Ce qui serait un plus, sans être obligatoire

  • Une connaissance de la profession comptable, du parcours vers le DEC ou de l’installation en cabinet.

  • Un réseau auprès de l’ANECS, du CJEC, des écoles de comptabilité-gestion, des incubateurs ou des réseaux de jeunes entrepreneurs.

  • Une expérience dans un environnement SaaS, fintech, outils de gestion ou accompagnement d’entrepreneurs.

  • La maîtrise de Salesforce, HubSpot, Brevo ou d’un outil comparable.

  • Une expérience de création de contenu B2B ou d’animation de réseaux sociaux professionnels.



Processus de recrutement :

  1. Échange de 30 minutes en visio avec un·e Business Recruiter.

  2. Entretien de 45 minutes avec Cyril Chanson, Manager Partenariats – Profession Comptable.

  3. Étude de cas d’une heure avec Cyril et Valentin Notteau, Head of Sales Accounting Firms, ou Claudia, Sales Team Lead — idéalement en présentiel.

data.title: Responsable Déploiement / Implementation Manager
data.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

 

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

 

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

 

🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations

Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.

L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Nous accompagnons chaque hôpital de A à Z dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.

Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations.

 

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

En tant qu'Operations Manager, tu seras au cœur du déploiement de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé :

 

Cadrage projet : organiser et animer les réunions de cadrage avec les établissements pour comprendre leurs besoins techniques et fonctionnels, et définir la meilleure intégration de nos solutions dans leur quotidien ; adapter ton discours selon tes interlocuteurs (responsables IT, chefs de projet, utilisateurs terrain).

Accompagnement fonctionnel : comprendre l'organisation des services hospitaliers et les parcours patients pour adapter nos solutions aux réalités terrain ; challenger les besoins clients et proposer les meilleures pratiques.

Déploiement technique : configurer nos applications et flux d'interopérabilité (HL7), orchestrer les échanges avec les équipes IT des hôpitaux ; maîtriser les aspects réseau, serveurs Windows, déploiement applicatif et sécurité.

Recette & résolution : vérifier le bon fonctionnement de bout en bout avec les clients, diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques ; qualifier les bugs et faire remonter les demandes d'évolution à l’équipe produit avec clarté et conviction.

Support expert : assurer le support niveau 2 en faisant le pont entre le support niveau 1 et la R&D ; monitorer proactivement les flux et certificats pour anticiper les incidents.

Amélioration continue : participer activement à l'optimisation de nos process internes et contribuer à des projets transverses ; partager tes retours terrain pour faire évoluer nos produits et nos méthodes.

Polyvalence produit : intervenir sur l'ensemble de nos solutions et développer une véritable expertise transverse.

Expérience en déploiement de projets à l'hôpital ou en healthtech avec déploiement hospitalier : Tu connais le monde hospitalier, son fonctionnement, ses contraintes.

Excellent communicant : Tu es à l'aise pour échanger avec différents interlocuteurs (IT, chefs de projet, utilisateurs), tu sais vulgariser et adapter ton discours.

Mindset doer : Tu n'as pas peur de mettre les mains dans le cambouis et d’être au coeur de l’opérationnel.

Autonome et proactif : Tu anticipes les problèmes, tu remontes rapidement les blocages, tu es force de proposition.

Compétences techniques (nice to have) : Connaissance en administration système (Windows Server, GPO), réseau (SFTP, VPN) et/ou interopérabilité HL7. Si tu viens de l'hôpital sans ces compétences, pas de problème, elles s'apprennent !

data.title: Field Marketing Specialist
data.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

The French market is one of Dust’s most important growth levers, and the Marketing team plays a central role in supporting pipeline generation through events, content and account-based activations.

As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation.

The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion.

You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme

  • Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery.

  • Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content.

  • Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity.

Own French social media and content activation

  • Own social media execution for Dust around events, campaigns and key French-market topics.

  • Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity.

  • Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences.

  • Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets.

Support partner marketing and Growth programmes

  • Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns.

  • Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials.

  • Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation.

Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B Marketing, ideally across Field Marketing, Event Marketing, Content Marketing or Product Marketing, preferably in SaaS or technology.

  • End-to-end event ownership with the ability to plan and deliver conferences, executive events and Dust-owned events, from preparation through execution and post-event follow-up.

  • Strong content and social media skills with experience creating or repurposing content for enterprise audiences across social media, landing pages, customer stories, YouTube, Sales enablement and executive LinkedIn profiles.

  • Commercial and pipeline mindset with a clear understanding of how events, content and account-based activities support Sales, BDRs, direct pipeline and partner-led growth.

  • Excellent communication skills in French and English, both written and spoken. You can write clearly and accurately, adapt your tone to different audiences and communicate credibly with enterprise executives.

  • Generalist and hands-on approach. You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. You anticipate needs, manage deadlines reliably and ensure that projects, events and content are properly prepared before launch.

  • Self-starter mentality. You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You know how to find and coordinate the right people across Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Customer Success, Partnerships and external partners.

  • Nice to have: Experience marketing to French enterprise or CAC 40 audiences, working with agencies or media partners, supporting paid campaigns, producing webinars or video content, and working with tools such as HubSpot, Google Workspace and Figma.

  • Location and travel: Based in Paris, comfortable working on-site and willing to travel occasionally for events in France.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct pipeline impact: Your work will directly support Sales and BDRs through events, content and ABM activations.

  • Execution ownership in France: You will turn the priorities defined by the France Marketing Lead into high-quality events, content, social media and partner marketing activations in France.

  • AI-native Marketing: You will use Dust to automate research, preparation, content production, reporting and follow-up.

  • Generalist scope: The role combines events, content, social media, webinars, Sales enablement and ABM.

  • Market-shaping opportunity: Help establish Dust as a leading voice in the French enterprise and agentic AI market.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Agents at work - Latent Space, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024

  • LLMs reasoning and agentic capabilities over time - dotAI, podcast with our cofounder, Stanislas Polu, 2024

data.title: Group Cost Controller
data.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As Group Cost Controller at Harmattan AI, you will take ownership of the Group’s Industrial, R&D & other operational costing, working closely with the FP&A Manager to structure, develop, and continuously improve Industrial P&L, Cost performance monitoring, and decision-support capabilities across multiple entities.

The role combines hands-on analytical execution with higher-level structuring responsibilities, including Industrial P&L creation & development, Industrial & R&D cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and KPI definition.

Responsibilities

  • Build the industrial P&L and the costing framework. Create the industrial P&L, define the standard cost calculation methodology, and set up the performance tracking processes that go with it.

  • Monitor and challenge production and inventory performance. Track production costs, inventory levels and variances, identify deviations early, and work with operations to close them.

  • Run the industrial management cycles. Initiate and own monthly closings, business reviews, forecasts and budgets for the industrial scope.

  • Contribute to the Odoo implementation. Work with Production and Supply Chain to ensure inventory is tracked reliably in the system and that the outputs the business needs come out of it.

  • Drive cost visibility and optimization beyond the plant. Follow R&D and project costs, and lead cost optimization initiatives across other operating costs.

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s preferred)

  • Industrial Controlling Expertise: 5–8 years in cost or industrial controlling within a manufacturing environment or a complex production environment

  • Modelling & Tools: Expert-level Excel and strong financial modelling skills, plus hands-on experience with an ERP . Comfortable with BOMs, standard costs and variance analysis.

  • Builder's Mindset & Adaptability: Has built a controlling framework from a blank page rather than inherited one. Autonomous, structured, and at ease in a fast-moving environment where the answer does not exist yet.

  • Business Partnering & Communication: A true business partner — curious about operations, comfortable on the shop floor, able to challenge production, engineering and procurement constructively. Fluent in French and English.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.title: Solution Architect (all genders)
data.description:
The Opportunity

AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate.

As AI agents become capable of executing increasingly complex workflows, enterprise buying decisions are becoming increasingly technical. Customers don't just want to hear what's possible—they want to see it working.

At Lio, we're building THE AI workforce for procurement.

As a Soltion Architect, you're not just supporting sales.

You're helping some of the world's largest enterprises gain the technical confidence to adopt AI. You'll build prototypes, lead technical workshops, solve customer challenges, and work side-by-side with our Account Executives to turn complex enterprise opportunities into successful deals.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical strategy of enterprise opportunities from first conversation to signed deal

  • Lead technical discovery sessions, workshops, and product evaluations with DAX companies and Fortune 500 customers

  • Build prototypes, proof of concepts, and custom extensions that demonstrate measurable business value

  • Design scalable solutions that integrate Lio into complex enterprise environments

  • Build trusted relationships with procurement leaders, IT teams, architects, and C-level stakeholders

  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to turn customer requirements into scalable platform capabilities

  • Help shape our enterprise sales strategy by combining technical expertise with commercial thinking

Your Profile

You'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy combining technology and customer interaction. You like building software just as much as presenting it to customers.

  • Have experience with APIs, SaaS platforms, cloud environments, or software development. You don't need to be a full-time engineer, but you're comfortable building and adapting technical solutions.

  • Take ownership. You enjoy influencing enterprise buying decisions and helping close complex technical deals.

  • Communicate confidently. Whether you're speaking with engineers, architects, procurement teams, or C-level executives, you know how to explain complex technology with clarity.

  • Thrive in fast-moving environments. You enjoy solving new challenges, learning quickly, and working across Sales, Product, and Engineering.

  • Are curious about AI and excited about helping enterprises adopt a new generation of software.

What's not required

You don't need experience in procurement or deep knowledge of ERP systems.

We're much more interested in technical curiosity, customer empathy, ownership, and your ability to solve complex problems than in having the perfect CV.

Why Join Lio?

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and built at Y Combinator. We're bringing Silicon Valley ambition and speed to Munich while building one of Europe's leading AI companies.

From day one, you'll work on strategic enterprise opportunities with Fortune 500 companies across Europe and the US. You'll help shape how AI is adopted inside global enterprises while working closely with Account Executives, Product, Engineering, and our founders.

If you're excited about combining software, enterprise sales, and AI to help win category-defining customers, we'd love to hear from you.

data.title: Commercial Analyst, DACH
data.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We are looking for an enthusiastic, driven, and proactive commercial analyst to join our expanding DACH go-to-market team. As a key member of our commercial team, you will play a crucial role in sourcing and qualifying leads, initiating outreach, and scheduling high-value conversations for our Account Executives. Your goal will be to create meaningful connections with healthcare practices and hospital groups, facilitating our mission to win across the DACH market.

This role requires a proactive mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a high-growth startup environment. You will become an expert in engaging healthcare stakeholders, driving new opportunities, and contributing directly to the sales pipeline.

What you’ll do

  • Identify, research, and prospect potential customers and formulate go-to-market strategies

  • Execute inbound and outbound campaigns using a mix of calls, emails, social selling, and product-led signals to qualify leads.

  • Schedule high-quality meetings and product demonstrations for Account Executives, ensuring smooth handoff of qualified opportunities.

  • Own and manage end-to-end sales cycles for small SMB customers, from initial outreach through to closing deals.

  • Maintain accurate records in HubSpot CRM, manage and optimise sales pipelines, and consistently meet targets for qualified leads generated.

  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives, Marketing, Product, Operations, and Customer Success teams to streamline sales strategies and market positioning.

  • Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and evolving customer needs to identify new opportunities.

What we're looking for

  • 1-2 years of experience in sales or in tech, banking, consulting, PE/VC or similar.

  • Proven success in generating leads, qualifying prospects, and managing high-volume outreach campaigns.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, able to quickly build rapport and articulate the value of Heidi’s AI-driven healthcare solutions.

  • Highly organised, disciplined, and results-oriented with a strong problem-solving ability and the ability to prioritise multiple tasks simultaneously.

  • Comfortable working independently in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment with a high degree of accountability.

  • Eager to learn, adaptable, and excited about professional growth opportunities.

Attitude is more important than experience so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem solving and building relationships we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

data.title: Head of Product - Clients (f/m/d)
data.description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

As Upvest continues to scale, we are looking for an exceptional Head of Product - Clients. You will work closely with Florian Thiel, Christian Wöhlke, and the Product & Engineering teams of the tribe (3 domain teams in total). In addition you will need to build strong relations with the Operations, Banking and Commercial leadership teams, owning topics critical to Upvest's product and business success.

Lead the clients tribe's product vision and strategy:

As Head of Product, you start leading one of the Clients tribe teams directly, while guiding the overarching strategy and success of the Clients Tribe and you start scaling yourself. You will work very closely with the Director of Engineering and VP of Product to define the tribe's strategy, set OKRs, and shape the long-term roadmap. The goal: to power Upvest's asymmetric scaling by building the intelligent, seamless "AI-experience", internal and external, that makes flawless API experiences the foundation of Upvest's ecosystem.

Drive asymmetric scaling through intelligent, agentic operations:

Your challenge is to make our tools and workflows scale without lockstep headcount growth.. That means embedding intelligence and automation into every process, and exploring how agentic operations, AI agents handling operational workflows end to end, can take on work that today needs manual effort. You'll be the go-to voice for applied AI across our tooling, helping the business run efficiently and helping clients get to market faster, at lower cost and higher reliability.

Take tooling into its next stage:

You'll own the roadmap for Internal Tooling or Upfront, both key strategic product enablers for scaling the business, and drive it forward through OKRs, deciding where to push deeper automation, broaden coverage, or reimagine a workflow entirely. You'll work directly with the Engineering team, and stay close to the people the products serve, so every step forward is one that truly matters.


What you’ll do:

  • Significant impact and strategic influence, shaping the roadmap and scaling strategy with a seat at the table with engineering and product leadership.

  • Autonomy coupled with inspirational leadership. You fully own the product success of your team and function.

  • Product-centricity throughout the organisation, with no struggle for relevance that product people may encounter elsewhere.

  • Product Engineering culture, working closely with engineering counterparts guided by joint OKRs and a clear roadmap.

  • An exceptional team, combining impactful work with a relaxed, fun atmosphere and consistently high eNPS.

  • Continuous learning across investments, API products, and a state-of-the-art tech stack.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in Product Management, ideally with a focus on internal and/or external tooling. Financial services, compliance, or fintech experience is a big plus.

  • Proven people leadership of teams of 3+ people.

  • Firm grasp of UI/UX best practices; can ideate and prototype through lo-fi wireframes and collaborate closely with design.

  • Strong track record of taking initiative, owning outcomes, and bridging dependencies.

  • Be a sponge. You don't need to be a finance or investment expert, but you'll need to absorb complex topics quickly (subledger reconciliation, mutual fund trading flow) and apply strong product fundamentals.

  • Experience with agile software development, delivering features and outcomes consistently.

  • Comfortable with product toolkits such as Linear, Slite, Miro, and Figma.

  • Familiarity with API documentation standards and an interest in how AI agents consume APIs (MCP or similar) is a strong plus.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: Technical Program Manager, Go
data.description:
Technical Program Manager, Go

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.

The Opportunity

Superhuman is building the AI-native future of work: a family of products people and companies rely on to think, write, and get things done faster, and we're looking for a Technical Program Manager to help shape what Superhuman Go becomes. You'd be joining a team that's rethinking what proactive AI can look like in practice. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and product management teams, shipping software that meaningfully anticipates and amplifies human productivity at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive engineering delivery end-to-end. You'll support the program management of multi-quarter engineering initiatives from planning through launch. That means working closely with engineering teams to track milestones, surface dependencies, and manage technical risks as they come up.

  • Translate engineering requirements into plans people can actually execute. You'll partner with engineering leads to break down technical work into phased delivery plans with clear milestones — identifying the critical path, spotting dependencies, and flagging resource constraints before they become problems. The goal is to give teams the clarity they need to make confident, autonomous decisions.

  • Get into the technical detail. You'll engage directly with engineers on architecture decisions, trade-offs, and system design. You do need to understand what's being built and why, so you can help the team make smart calls about scope, quality, and when something is ready to ship.

  • Track and improve engineering health. You'll keep an eye on delivery metrics, flag risks early, and run post-launch retrospectives to capture what you've learned. You'll work with engineering and data teams to establish the signals that tell you whether a system is doing what it should — and act quickly when it isn't.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in a fast-scaling tech environment. You're either coming from a technical background (Software Engineering, , QA, Data Engineering, or similar) and stepping into program management, or you've been a Program Manager before and want to go deeper on the engineering side.

  • Enough technical depth to earn engineering trust. You understand how software systems are built — whether from hands-on experience writing code, working in data infrastructure, or spending real time embedded with engineering teams.

  • Strong programme management fundamentals, or the drive to build them. You understand (or are genuinely eager to learn) how to run a delivery cadence: planning cycles, dependency tracking, risk management, and keeping stakeholders in the loop. If you're coming from a pure engineering background, you're coachable and excited to develop this side of your skillset.

  • You're proactive and organized. You don't wait to be told what needs to be done — you gather context, spot gaps, and get moving. You can hold multiple engineering workstreams in your head at once without losing sight of what matters most.

  • You build real credibility with engineers. Whether through a shared technical background or genuine curiosity about how things work, you earn trust with engineering teams, not by managing them from above, but by making their work easier and their path to delivery clearer.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and move with purpose. Shifting priorities don't throw you off — you adapt quickly and stay focused. You know when to push forward and when to slow down and get the right alignment before committing a team to a direction.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional Growth: We believe autonomy and trust are what allow people to do their best, most innovative work — in a way that plays to their strengths and fits their life.

  • A connected team: We build a product that helps people connect, and we try to live that in how we work together too. Our remote-first, hybrid model supports a genuinely collaborative culture rooted in our values. We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all — especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech — to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, colour, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The Opportunity

As a Systems Engineer on Superhuman's Corporate Infrastructure team, you will design and lead the automation, security, and scalability of our company’s identity and endpoint management platforms. You’ll help architect, implement, and evolve the core systems responsible for identity lifecycle, secure device posture, automation, and compliance—foundations that empower every Superhuman employee to work securely and efficiently at scale.

Unlike traditional Help Desk roles, this is a high-impact, engineering-focused position dedicated to building and automating the underlying platforms and tools for identity & access management and device fleet operations. Your work will span areas such as endpoint provisioning, zero-touch deployment, compliance automation, and security policy enforcement.

You will collaborate closely with other engineers, security, IT, and business partners to deliver systems and self-service capabilities that enable seamless and secure productivity across macOS, Windows, and mobile devices.

In this role, you will

  • Architect and lead the development of scalable systems for identity lifecycle management, device fleet provisioning, compliance hardening, and endpoint automation.

  • Design and implement solutions that ensure identity and device access is secure, manageable, and automated across a rapidly scaling organization.

  • Build automation around Okta, Jamf Pro, Workspace ONE, and underlying platforms using Python, PowerShell, bash, and Git.

  • Lead migration and platform consolidation efforts (e.g., UEM platform moves, IdP cutovers, M&A integrations) to streamline integration and reduce operational complexity.

  • Automate joiner-mover-leaver workflows to automate employee lifecycle workflows.

  • Develop self-service and reliability tooling that reduces manual operational work and empowers end users and internal teams.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (security, IT, engineering, finance) to design access policies, implement compliance controls, and integrate device trust with identity frameworks.

  • Mentor team members, set technical direction, and help define the charter and short- and long-term roadmaps of the Corporate Infrastructure team.

Qualifications

data.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We seek an ambitious and motivated candidate to join as a Senior Sales Executive DACH and support the Sales team. In this role, you will report to the Sales Manager and be instrumental in achieving our ambitious goals within the Swiss Market.

Ultimately, you’ll help us meet and surpass business expectations and contribute to our company’s rapid growth. The ideal person has a pioneering mindset, is hungry, perseverant, and focused, and is not afraid to hit the phone to engage with new customers.

We’ll value someone with a curious mind who is interested in bringing their great Perk experience to a new role. Perfect for a person who is looking to have a significant impact on a scaling sales organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Focus on mid to large enterprise companies (250 - 5000+ employees) headquartered in Switzerland

  • Take on additional responsibility within the team, identify and take ownership and drive projects that bring value to the wider business:

  • Generate new clients for our outstanding travel and spend technology

  • Own the entire sales process from the first touchpoint, present product demos to potential clients, negotiate and do the follow-up until closing the deal;

  • Understand the needs of our target prospects and articulate the value that Perk provides. Follow the entire sales cycle;

  • Stay up-to-date with new features and product launches;

  • Help define and establish best practices together with the broader team;

  • Monitor and report on sales performance analytics and forecasts;

  • Mastering to consult conservative clients into digital opportunities;

  • Owning the conversations between C level stakeholders in finance, procurement, IT, and travel management;

  • Evaluate the existing infrastructure of the clients and consult the individual SaaS solutions;

  • Suggest innovative upsell / partner ideas to increase sales and improve customer experience.

What We’re Looking For

  • Being a native German speaker and fluent in English is a must;

  • Fluency in French is a plus

  • Possess excellent communication, presentation, and public speaking skills;

  • Be hungry and ambitious, yet ethical and sound;

  • Be able to work as an individual contributor, but remember you are part of a team;

  • Be a customer-centric mindset.

What We Offer

  • 30 days of annual leave to rest and recharge, plus all public holidays.

  • Your choice of perk: a gym membership (Urban Sports Club) or a BVG public transport ticket.

  • Competitive compensation paired with equity in Perk.

  • Unforgettable team experiences, including our annual summer party.

  • Comprehensive wellbeing support through Spring Health, offering fast access to 12 therapy and 12 coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Flexible compensation options to help your money go further.

  • 17 weeks of paid parental leave during your child’s first year.

  • 16 paid volunteer hours each year to give back to causes you care about.

  • Up to 20 “Work From Anywhere” days annually to explore the world while staying connected.

  • A fully paid four-week sabbatical after five years with Perk.

  • Relocation support to help you move seamlessly into one of our hubs.

Interview Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins Virtual or IRL if possible

  • Assessment Interview - 60mins - In-person Interview

  • Values Interview - 30mins virtual

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

data.title: Manager, Data Platform
data.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the development and evolution of its shared data platform in a hands-on technical leadership role. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role. You will lead a Berlin-based team, set technical direction, make key architecture decisions, and get directly involved in the hardest platform and reliability problems. The team owns shared data infrastructure and raw data quality foundations, including ingestion, storage, orchestration, runtime, and platform governance. You will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Operations, Security, and Product partners to build a scalable, trusted, and cost-effective platform for analytics, reporting, experimentation, and machine learning.

This role is required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the roadmap for KAYAK’s shared data platform.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing Berlin-based team of data platform engineers.

  • Evolve the platform architecture across ingestion, storage, orchestration, runtime, and lakehouse foundations.

  • Build core capabilities such as schema registry, data contracts, observability, metadata, and semantic layer implementation.

  • Enforce data retention policies and platform controls for different data types and usage needs.

  • Improve platform reliability by building the tooling and platform capabilities needed for monitoring, alerting, incident response, and operational readiness.

  • Drive platform modernization and simplify legacy systems where it creates clear value.

  • Define clear ownership boundaries so the platform team owns shared infrastructure and raw data quality, while downstream teams own business logic.


Please apply if:

  • You have 8+ years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, data architecture, or a related role.

  • You have meaningful people-management experience and a high technical bar.

  • You have strong knowledge of large-scale data platform architecture, including streaming, batch, storage, orchestration, and distributed query engines.

  • You have hands-on experience with technologies relevant to KAYAK’s stack, such as Kafka, Flink, Iceberg, Trino, AWS, Kubernetes, Airflow, Python, SQL, and schema-based data contracts.

  • You have led platforms with high-throughput event streams and large-scale analytical data.

  • You have led platform migrations or infrastructure modernization efforts with strong judgment on risk, reliability, cost, and business continuity.

  • You are comfortable working across Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Operations, Security, and Product on technically complex topics.

  • You bring high ownership, sound judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 6 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Public transportation subsidies

  • Bike leasing program

  • Monthly social events, Thursday happy hours, sports teams

  • An awesome office in Friedrichshain, Berlin

     

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

At KAYAK for Business, we're building the future of corporate travel technology — and the engineering teams behind it are at the heart of that mission. As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead one or more agile engineering teams delivering software that helps companies and their travelers move smarter and with less friction, while playing a key role in shaping our growing engineering hub.

This role will be required to work from our Berlin office at least 3 days per week.

In this role you will:

  • Own end-to-end delivery for one or more agile engineering teams, ensuring the team consistently ships high-quality software aligned with product and business objectives, measured against clear KPIs.

  • Define and drive the technical roadmap for your team's domain — collaborating with product managers and peer engineering leaders to translate business goals into a prioritized, executable plan.

  • Design and enforce engineering best practices across the team's codebase, including coding standards, testing strategies, observability, and clear Definition of Done criteria, raising the overall quality bar.

  • Lead hiring and performance management for a team of software engineers, owning the full employee lifecycle from sourcing and onboarding through career development, performance reviews, and promotions.

  • Coach and develop engineers at all levels — including senior engineers and emerging technical leads — through regular 1:1s, structured feedback, and deliberate career conversations that build the next generation of leaders.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and peer engineering managers to plan and deliver complex, multi-team initiatives, ensuring clear alignment on scope, dependencies, and timelines.

  • Identify and remove delivery risks proactively — whether organizational, technical, or process-related — and drive improvements without waiting to be directed, keeping the team operating at high velocity.

  • Champion a culture of quality and continuous improvement, embedding practices such as blameless post-mortems, structured incident response, and iterative process refinement into the team's day-to-day rhythm.

  • Influence technical architecture across the team's domain by preparing and participating in design reviews, guiding architectural decisions, and ensuring systems are built for scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Help build and shape the engineering presence, contributing to local talent acquisition, onboarding, and team culture as part of the organization's strategic expansion of its engineering hub.

Please apply if you have:

  • 1+ years of experience leading engineering teams within the travel industry focused on supplier integrations (such as flights, hotels, or trains using Direct APIs, GDS, NDC, NDC[X]) or managing teams executing large-scale third-party content integrations.

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years in an engineering leadership or management role directly managing software engineers, and a proven track record of leading productive teams and shipping high-quality software in a fast-paced environment; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills considered.

  • A proven track record of ownership and innovation within a data-driven, results-oriented environment, along with the ability to rapidly learn and master new business domains.

  • A track record of steering organizational transformation, maximizing gains from agile methodologies, and fostering process optimization and innovation

  • Strong technical fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, and backend service architecture, with the ability to credibly guide architectural decisions and participate meaningfully in design reviews.

  • Demonstrated experience owning the full people management lifecycle — hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and promotions — with a genuine commitment to developing engineering talent.

  • Experience coaching and developing engineers at multiple levels, including senior engineers and emerging technical leads, through structured feedback, regular 1:1s, and deliberate career conversations.

  • Solid understanding of agile delivery methodologies and the software development lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability practices; comfortable driving process improvements within a sprint-based team.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate a clear technical vision to both technical and non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively across product, design, and engineering functions.

  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

  • Hands-on experience with modern software development tooling — including version control systems (e.g., GitHub), issue tracking (e.g., Jira), and logging or observability platforms — and a demonstrated openness to adopting AI-assisted development tools to improve team productivity.

  • Comfort working in a distributed, multilingual engineering organization with teams across multiple time zones and office locations.

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; no specific certification is required.

data.description:
Deine Rolle:

Als (Junior) Relationship Manager Investments (m/w/d) bekommst du die Chance, aktiv zum Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens beizutragen und dich in der Betreuung anspruchsvoller und vermögender Kund:innen weiterzuentwickeln. Du bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere Kund:innen und repräsentierst LIQID im täglichen Austausch. Dein Auftreten, deine Lernbereitschaft sowie deine Serviceorientierung tragen maßgeblich dazu bei, langfristige und vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen.


Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Fokus auf Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen: Du stehst unseren vermögenden Bestandskund:innen bei allen Fragen rund um das Thema Vermögensverwaltung und Marktgeschehen kompetent und verlässlich zur Seite. Dabei baust du aktiv eine Vertrauensbasis zu deiner Kundschaft auf, sicherst die Zufriedenheit und entwickelst Kundenbeziehungen durch deine zielgerichtete und serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Individuelle Lösungen anbieten: Du erkennst die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Kund:innen und begeisterst sie für unsere Anlageprodukte. Gleichzeitig informierst du sie über aktuelle Anlagestrategien und Depotumschichtungen und bringst dein wachsendes Marktverständnis gezielt in die Beratung ein.

  • Teil eines innovativen Teams sein: Du übermittelst nicht nur das Feedback unserer Kund:innen, sondern bringst auch eigene Impulse in die Teams für Sales, Marketing, Operations und Tech ein. So gestaltest du aktiv die externe Kommunikation mit und trägst zur Weiterentwicklung von Produkten und Plattformen im Sinne unseres Klientels bei.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Background: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Berufsausbildung (idealerweise Bankausbildung) oder ein erfolgreich absolviertes Studium (bevorzugt im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen).

  • Skills und Qualifikationen: Du hast bereits erste relevante Berufserfahrung in der Kundenberatung im Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld gesammelt. Dabei konntest du ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Finanzprodukte und verschiedene Anlageklassen entwickeln. Du interessierst dich für globale Kapitalmärkte sowie aktuelle wirtschaftliche und politische Entwicklungen und verfolgst diese regelmäßig. Eine strukturierte, serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude am Umgang mit Kund:innen zeichnen dich aus. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Mindset: Du bist verantwortungsbewusst, zuverlässig und zeichnest dich durch eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung aus. Außerdem bist du kommunikationsstark und kannst dich durch private und berufliche Berührungspunkte ausgezeichnet in unsere Zielgruppe hineinversetzen. Du arbeitest selbstständig, setzt die richtigen Prioritäten und begegnest Herausforderungen proaktiv mit einer Hands-on-Mentalität. Du hast keine Schwierigkeiten damit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld Bestleistungen abzurufen.


Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung!

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten.

  • Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten.

  • Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen.

  • Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display.

  • Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern.

  • Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus.

So geht es für dich weiter:

Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte.

  • Erstes Kennenlernen mit unserem Recruiting-Team via Videocall.

  • Videointerview mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen.

  • Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du triffst das Team und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Arbeit eines Relationship Managers.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit.

Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem betreuten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust und Project A zusammen.

LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt.
